items.title_en: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
items.title_zh: 法國指控伊朗在冰箱攻擊事件中進行網路「破壞」
items.summary_en: French officials say Iranian hackers attacked 700 stores. They changed the temperatures in refrigerators. This caused a lot of food to go bad.
items.summary_zh: 法國官員表示，伊朗駭客攻擊了 700 家商店。他們改變了冰箱的溫度，導致大量食物變質。
items.why_important_en: This shows how cyberattacks can damage physical businesses and supply chains.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了網路攻擊如何損害實體企業與供應鏈。

vocab.definition_en: To say that someone has done something wrong.
vocab.sentence_en: The manager did not accuse me of making the mistake.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理沒有指控是我犯了那個錯誤。

vocab.definition_en: To become bad or not fit to eat.
vocab.sentence_en: Don't leave the milk out or it will spoil.
vocab.sentence_zh: 別把牛奶放在外面，否則會變質。

items.title_en: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
items.title_zh: 最高法院裁定德州西部的邊境圍牆工程可繼續進行
items.summary_en: The US government asked the Supreme Court to keep building a wall. The court said the work can continue. This is happening while a legal case is still active.
items.summary_zh: 美國政府要求最高法院繼續修建圍牆。法院裁定工程可以繼續。此舉是在法律訴訟仍在進行時發生的。
items.why_important_en: It highlights the ongoing legal battles over government infrastructure projects.
items.why_important_zh: 這凸顯了政府基礎建設項目中持續存在的法律爭議。

vocab.sentence_en: The construction of the new office will finish soon.
vocab.sentence_zh: 新辦公室的建設很快就會完成。

vocab.definition_en: An act of asking for something.
vocab.sentence_en: Please send your request by email to the team.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請透過電子郵件將您的請求發送給團隊。

items.title_en: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
items.title_zh: 我們對輝達執行長與疑似中國間諜的外遇了解多少？
items.summary_en: Nvidia's CEO is in the news for a personal relationship. People are talking about his reputation. It is unclear how this will affect his company.
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長因個人關係登上新聞。人們正在討論他的名聲。目前尚不清楚這將如何影響他的公司。
items.why_important_en: High-profile scandals involving tech leaders can impact company stock and public trust.
items.why_important_zh: 涉及科技領袖的高調醜聞可能會影響公司股價與公眾信任。

vocab.definition_en: The opinion that people have about someone.
vocab.sentence_en: This company has a good reputation for customer service.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家公司在客戶服務方面有很好的聲譽。

vocab.definition_en: To continue to exist after a difficult situation.
vocab.sentence_en: Can the small business survive this difficult year?
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家小企業能度過這艱難的一年嗎？

items.title_en: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
items.title_zh: 英國喜劇演員羅素·布蘭德因強姦與性侵被判處超過 10 年徒刑
items.summary_en: A famous British comedian was found guilty of serious crimes. A court sentenced him to more than 10 years in prison. Six women brought the case against him.
items.summary_zh: 一位著名的英國喜劇演員被判犯有嚴重罪行。法院判處他超過 10 年監禁。六名女性對他提起了訴訟。
items.why_important_en: This case shows that legal consequences apply even to famous celebrities.
items.why_important_zh: 此案顯示即使是知名名人也必須承擔法律後果。

vocab.definition_en: Responsible for doing something wrong or illegal.
vocab.sentence_en: The jury found the man guilty of the crime.
vocab.sentence_zh: 陪審團裁定該男子犯有此罪。

vocab.definition_en: A legal matter that is decided in a court.
vocab.sentence_en: The lawyer is working on a very important case.
vocab.sentence_zh: 律師正在處理一個非常重要的案件。

items.title_en: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs and outsource work to India under AI-driven overhaul
items.title_zh: 澳洲航空在 AI 驅動的改革下將裁減 850 個澳洲職位並外包至印度
items.summary_en: Qantas is cutting 850 jobs in Australia. They will send this work to India instead. The company is using new AI technology to change how it works.
items.summary_zh: 澳洲航空正在裁減澳洲的 850 個職位。他們將把這些工作轉移到印度。該公司正在使用新的 AI 技術來改變其運作方式。
items.why_important_en: This reflects a trend of companies using AI to replace local jobs with cheaper offshore labor.
items.why_important_zh: 這反映了企業利用 AI 以更便宜的海外勞動力取代本地職位的趨勢。

vocab.definition_en: To pay another company to do work for you.
vocab.sentence_en: We decided to outsource our IT support to a firm.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們決定將 IT 支援外包給一家公司。

vocab.definition_en: A formal decision between two or more people or groups.
vocab.sentence_en: Both sides signed the agreement this morning.
vocab.sentence_zh: 雙方今天早上簽署了協議。
